name: OAHObservationTechnique
title: OneAquaHealth Observation Ascertainment Techniques
publisher: OneAquaHealth Consortium - Semantic Interoperability Working Group
description: Physical, instrument, or algorithmic ascertainment techniques compliant with FHIR R4 Observation.method semantics.

concept.definition: Visual sighting or qualitative photographic report submitted by citizen scientists via the OneAquaHealth mobile application.
Automated, calibrated hardware sensor telemetry measuring physical-chemical aquatic parameters (e.g., pH, dissolved oxygen, water temperature, turbidity).
Synthetic ecological or vector prediction produced by algorithmic models such as DipteraCAST.
Reference analytical chemistry, mass spectrometry, or microbial culturing performed on physical water grab samples.
